notes: Consumer-side animation specification for the Reimu Eating Set v1.
This file is NOT a Sprite Harness Animation Plan; tools/build_reimu_animations.py deterministically expands it into one legal plan per state and drives the public sprite-harness CLI.

The current sources are flattened single-image sprites (base.png) that include the low table, food, and tatami. Whole-sprite motion moves the ground line and the food together with the character, so this baseline is deliberately an identity hold: one validated frame per state.
Local eating motion (breathing, head bob, chewing, blink) requires explicit layered source assets and an Animation Plan v2; see docs/sprite-harness-integration.md.
